title: Guided and Assisted Payment Gateway Onboarding in India: A New Merchant Support Guide
summary: Learn how guided and assisted payment gateway onboarding works in India, what support covers, how to request help and how to prepare for your first payment.
body_markdown:
Guided payment gateway onboarding helps new merchants understand registration, verification and payment setup through instructions, prompts and status updates. Assisted payment gateway onboarding in India adds human help with that journey. If you are starting a business, your question may be simple: can someone guide me from registration to my first payment?


A document request, pending review or unfamiliar setup screen can leave you unsure what to do next or whom to contact. A dashboard and an assigned onboarding manager provide different kinds of help. Paying for assistance does not bypass verification.


This guide explains your support options and how to use them. Razorpay offers[paid Assisted Onboarding](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding) , with a dedicated manager supporting signup, KYC submission, verification, and activation. You still need to meet the applicable requirements.


You will learn what to prepare, how to request assistance, and what to check before your first live payment.


## Key Takeaways


- **Razorpay offers a[paid Assisted Onboarding service](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding) for new merchants in India** . A dedicated onboarding manager helps with signup, KYC document submission, verification and account activation, with assistance continuing through the first transaction. Account approval remains subject to verification and business review.


- **Request human assistance through the signup flow.** Razorpay’s Assisted Onboarding option lets you hire a dedicated onboarding manager for an additional fee. Review the current price, availability and included support before purchasing the service.
- **Choose the support model that matches your needs.** Guided self-service helps you follow digital instructions, while assisted onboarding adds human help. Confirm ongoing account management or partner onboarding separately if you need support beyond your own account setup.
- **Use assistance to understand and complete the next step.** An onboarding manager can guide you through the application journey, but cannot replace required verification. Check the specific clarification or document request so you know what to submit next.
- **Prepare documents for your business type.** Individuals, proprietors, partnerships, LLPs and companies may need different evidence. Follow your application’s checklist, upload readable documents and check that business, identity and bank details match the supporting records.
- **Choose a payment collection tool that fits how you sell.**[Payment Links](https://razorpay.com/payment-links/) let you share a collection link, while[Payment Pages](https://razorpay.com/payment-pages/) provide a hosted payment page. These options can simplify payment setup, but verification and activation requirements still apply.
- **Track testing, activation, live payments and settlement separately.** A successful test does not confirm live readiness, and a successful collection does not mean funds have reached your bank. Keep your application reference, current status and existing support ticket together when requesting help.


## What Is Guided or Assisted Payment Gateway Onboarding?


Guided onboarding helps you follow the registration, verification and setup process through instructions and prompts. Assisted onboarding adds a person who helps you navigate those steps. Confirm who will help, which stages they cover, whether assistance costs extra, and how you can contact them.


### Guided Digital Setup


A guided flow explains the information needed next and shows progress or document requests. It helps you complete the application yourself. A pending status alone does not establish that an onboarding manager has been assigned.


### Human Assistance and Its Scope


An onboarding manager helps you navigate account setup and activation. Answering a support question, coordinating an application and delivering a custom integration are different activities. Ask which team owns your next action and what your chosen service covers, especially if you need help beyond account activation.


> **DID YOU KNOW:** A test payment checks a setup flow without moving real money. It does not establish readiness for live collections. See[Test and Live Modes](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/test-live-modes/) .


## What Can Onboarding Support Help With, and What Still Requires Verification?


Onboarding support helps you understand the next action, prepare requested information and follow the application through setup. It does not replace identity checks, business review, or technical testing. Ask whether your chosen service covers document submission, clarification requests, activation coordination, and help with your first transaction.


### Help the Merchant Can Request


- Explain the current document request and where to respond.
- Identify which submitted detail needs clarification.
- Confirm who handles verification and technical questions.
- Clarify the handoff for your first transaction or an unresolved query.


Confirm coverage rather than assuming every service includes each activity.


### Assistance Cannot Guarantee Approval


A manager cannot replace the required review, and paying for help does not purchase approval. The RBI’s payment aggregator directions require merchant due diligence. Additional information can still be requested. A clarification request is not automatically a rejection.


> **PRO-TIP:** Ask: “What is missing, where should I submit it and who is reviewing it?” A specific question helps you understand the next action.


## Which Onboarding Support Model Fits Your Business?


Choose guided self-service if you can complete setup with documentation. Consider human assistance when you need help navigating those steps. Ask separately about ongoing account management for support after launch, or partner onboarding if your platform sets up accounts for other merchants.


### Support Model Comparison


Support models for a new merchant Support model What it means Best fit What to confirm


Guided self-service You follow the digital flow and documentation A merchant comfortable with online forms and setup Where questions and clarification requests are handled


Assisted onboarding A person helps with the onboarding journey A new merchant who needs setup guidance Fee, availability, covered stages and engagement endpoint


Ongoing account management A continuing commercial or operational relationship A business seeking support after launch Eligibility, contracted scope and response arrangements


Partner onboarding Infrastructure for a platform onboarding merchants A business managing other merchant accounts Partner requirements, consent and integration responsibilities


### Choose by the Task You Need Help With


A proprietor unsure about a document request needs guidance for one application. A marketplace onboarding multiple sellers needs a different arrangement, including each seller’s verification and a platform workflow.


Razorpay’s[Sub-Merchant Onboarding APIs](https://razorpay.com/docs/api/partners/) support that separate journey. The[workflow requires enrolment in the partner programme](https://razorpay.com/docs/partners/aggregators/onboarding-api/workflow/) . A business collecting its own payments does not need partner APIs simply to request onboarding help.


## Getting Started Without a Dedicated Tech Team


A business without developers can choose a payment collection flow that matches how it sells. Payment Links suit sharing a collection link, while hosted Payment Pages provide a branded page. Neither removes account verification. Ask for help choosing the flow before committing to a custom checkout build.


### Match the Collection Tool to the Sales Journey


- [Payment Links](https://razorpay.com/payment-links/) : share a collection request with a customer.
- [Payment Pages](https://razorpay.com/payment-pages/) : use a hosted payment page without building your own checkout. See our guide to[accepting payments without a website](https://razorpay.com/blog/accept-payments-without-website) .
- [Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/payment-gateway/) : accept payments through a website or app checkout.


Confirm website development, plugin configuration, and custom engineering separately from account-setup assistance.


## What Should You Prepare Before Asking for Onboarding Help?


Prepare your business entity details, authorised person’s information, bank details and the documents requested in your application. Keep your application reference and pending step available. The right checklist depends on your business type and verification route, so use current requirements rather than a universal document list.


### A Document Readiness Check


Individuals, proprietorships, partnerships, LLPs and companies can be asked for different evidence. Check the[official business-type KYC requirements](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/business-types-kyc-documents/) and our[KYC onboarding guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/payment-gateway-kyc-onboarding-india/) .


1. Check that uploaded files are readable and complete.
2. Confirm the selected entity type matches your business.
3. Check submitted identity and bank details against the supporting records.


Do not assume GST registration, a current account, or one identity document list applies to every merchant. Follow the requirements in your actual application.


### If Existing CKYC Details Are Available


Existing Central KYC records may allow details to be fetched with your consent. Additional information can still be needed. Retrieval changes how evidence is provided, not whether verification applies.


> **DID YOU KNOW:** Razorpay documents an existing-record CKYC route and a fallback journey. See[account setup and verification](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/) for the route relevant to your application.


## How to Resolve Common Onboarding Blockers With Support


When onboarding stalls, check the latest application status and the specific dashboard request. Send support the application reference, pending step, relevant message, and what you have already corrected. Ask what remains outstanding and continue in the same case so the review history stays together.


### Name, Document or Bank-Detail Questions


For example, if an application requests a legal business detail and you entered a trading name, ask which field needs correction and what evidence is required. Respond to the fields or documents identified in the request rather than resubmitting everything.


For bank verification, follow the requested proof process. Do not assume any cheque image will be accepted. Check readability and the details reviewers must verify.


### Pending Review or a Clarification Request


Razorpay’s[initial account-setup guide](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/) explains that clarifications can be requested during review. Check whether information is pending from you, the application is awaiting review, or another team needs to act. If the application is rejected, seek clarification of the stated reason through official support.


> **PRO-TIP:** Keep one case summary: application reference, current status, requested correction and existing ticket number. Reply to that ticket when continuing the same issue.


## Moving From Setup Help to Your First Live Payment


Your first live payment requires both an activated account and a working collection flow. Use test mode to prepare the flow, confirm the account is ready for live use, then check the live configuration and payment result. Support should help you identify which milestone is incomplete instead of treating every issue as KYC.


### A Practical Launch Sequence


1. Choose the collection flow that matches how you sell.
2. Complete the application and respond to verification requests.
3. Prepare the flow in test mode where supported.
4. Check successful, failed, and cancelled payment behaviour relevant to that flow.
5. Confirm account activation and any required product enablement. Your account moves to an activated state on successful completion of signup and KYC verification, and you can view activation details from[Account & Settings](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/account-settings/activation-details/) .
6. Switch custom integrations to the correct live credentials and configuration. A non-API tool follows its own documented launch steps.
7. Confirm a successful live payment in the dashboard, then review the applicable settlement cycle separately.


### Check Each Milestone Separately


Milestones from testing to bank settlement Milestone What it establishes What still needs checking


Test access A sandbox flow can be prepared Verification and live readiness


Account activation The account is approved for live use Chosen product and integration configuration


Live payment A real collection has succeeded Payment status and the applicable settlement cycle


Bank settlement Collected funds have reached the bank Reconciliation with the payment and settlement records


Razorpay documents a[standard domestic cycle of T+2 working days](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/settlements/?preferred-country=IN) , where T is the date the payment is captured. Check your dashboard for your applicable cycle. The[settlements FAQ](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/settlements/faqs/?preferred-country=IN) explains that the cycle can vary with bank approval, business type, and risk.


### Technical Help Has a Different Scope


For implementation steps, use the[Standard Checkout guide](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-gateway/web-integration/standard/) . Ask your manager or support team how technical questions are handled, and confirm whether custom integration work is included in your agreed service scope.


A successful collection and the arrival of funds in your bank account are separate events with separate timelines.


## Extra Questions for Complex Businesses and Additional Payment Products


If your business has additional requirements, describe them before choosing a support arrangement. Ask whether they involve extra verification, product activation or a separate implementation team. Standard account onboarding does not establish that international payments, recurring billing or a platform’s sub-merchant flow is already enabled.


### Explain the Business Model Early


Multiple sellers, recurring charges and international customers each change what reviewers need to see. State your legal entity, what you sell and the intended payment flow when you ask which requirements apply.


### Separate Account Setup From Product Enablement


Getting an account activated is not the same as having every payment capability switched on. Check the current documentation for the specific product you need. Direct regulatory questions to the appropriate compliance adviser and confirm product eligibility separately. Onboarding assistance does not guarantee approval of every requested capability.


## How to Track and Escalate an Onboarding Support Request


Track the application and support ticket together. Keep the ticket reference and respond with the requested information. If the ticket exceeds its committed resolution timeline and an escalation option appears, use that route. A reply or callback is not an account-activation promise.


### Use the Available Dashboard Support Route


Follow the[official support instructions](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/support/?preferred-country=IN) : open Help in the dashboard, choose the relevant support option and describe the issue concisely.


Only Owner and Admin roles can raise queries through the[Support Tickets tab](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/account-settings/support-tickets/?preferred-country=IN) . Check the appropriate account role if that route is unavailable. Confirm your assigned manager’s contact process during the engagement.


### Escalate Through the Documented Process


Escalate Now appears when a ticket’s committed turnaround time or service level is not met. Escalation addresses the support request; it does not override verification or guarantee application approval.


> **DID YOU KNOW:** Chat and callback options are available to selected users. Check which contact options are visible for your account instead of assuming universal access.


## How Razorpay’s Assisted Onboarding Works for New Merchants


Razorpay offers paid Assisted Onboarding with a dedicated manager helping through signup, KYC submission, verification and activation, with assistance through the first transaction. Its published service description lists manager assignment within 1 hour and activation within 8 business hours. Confirm the fee, availability and applicable conditions before purchasing; verification requirements still apply.


### What the Official Documentation Says


The[Assisted Onboarding description](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding) explains the support journey. Check three details before choosing it:


- **Price and terms:** It has an additional fee. Check the current signup flow for the amount, eligibility and any refund conditions.
- **Timings:** Confirm when the stated assignment and activation periods begin, their operating conditions and any pending requirements.
- **Engagement endpoint:** Help through the first transaction does not establish ongoing account-management entitlement.


For the separate speed and verification-route discussion, see[faster payment gateway onboarding](https://razorpay.com/blog/faster-payment-gateway-onboarding-india) .


### How to Request an Onboarding Manager


1. Open the official Razorpay signup flow and register using your mobile number.
2. Open Know more under the option to hire an onboarding manager.
3. Review the amount, service description and terms before completing payment.
4. Follow the assignment process and provide the requested application information.
5. If the option is not visible, ask official support which route is available.


> **PRO-TIP:** Confirm the contact route, included setup activities and engagement endpoint before paying. Keep the acknowledgement and case reference.


## New Merchant Onboarding Support Checklist


Before requesting help, collect the details below so the next action is clear.


Details to prepare before requesting support Check What to have ready Question for the support team


Business identity Selected entity type and requested evidence Have I entered the correct business details?


Verification Current status and latest clarification What information is still required from me?


Bank details Accurate account information and requested proof Which detail failed verification?


Payment setup Collection tool, test result and relevant error Is this an activation or setup issue?


Assisted service Fee and terms acknowledgement, if purchased Which activities and milestones are covered?


Follow-up Application reference and existing ticket What is the next action and who owns it?


Never share OTPs, API secrets or full identity documents in public comments or forums. Use the official submission process for requested records.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Which payment gateway provides guided or assisted onboarding support for new merchants in India?


Razorpay offers[paid Assisted Onboarding](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding) with a dedicated manager who helps with signup, KYC submission, verification and activation, with assistance continuing through the first transaction. Review the current signup option and applicable terms. Remember that human assistance does not remove verification requirements.


### Is Razorpay’s Assisted Onboarding free?


No. Razorpay describes Assisted Onboarding as an additional-fee service. The reviewed public setup documentation does not state a fixed amount. Check the price and applicable terms in the current signup flow before paying, and confirm what help is included. Do not confuse this service fee with payment processing charges.


### Does an onboarding manager guarantee KYC approval?


No. Assistance helps you understand and complete the onboarding process. It does not replace verification or business review. Your application may still need additional information. Ask which specific requirement is pending and where to submit the correction, rather than assuming a paid service guarantees approval.


### Can I start without developers or a custom website checkout?


You can choose simple collection tools such as Payment Links or hosted Payment Pages instead of building a custom checkout. The suitable option depends on how you sell and which features you need. Account verification and activation requirements still apply, and a custom API integration may require developer help.


### What should I do if my onboarding application is stuck?


Check the latest dashboard status and clarification request, then contact your assigned manager where applicable or use official support. Include the application reference, pending step and existing ticket number. Use the documented escalation option when it appears after a committed ticket resolution timeline is missed.
